verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `there are continuous symmetric multilinear maps $T_k:X^k\to Y$`.
evidence: [M] assumes the stencil bound for every R > 1 (D-section.tex:759). In [L], `Scout` needs 1 ≤ R (Ray/Gain.lean:24), and `Rebar.recovery` (Ray/Anchor.lean:23) needs 1 ≤ a < p and gives (1−a/p)⁻¹C. So 2C at a = R/2 needs R ≥ 2, and only then does `fee (R/2) r` = 4e/(rR) (Amp/Head.lean:13, `course` :78) give 2C(4e/(rR))^k. `gardenL` is a polarization (Head.lean:15,77), but no Amp lemma states that it is symmetric.

`Rebar.recovery` (FullVolume/Ray/Anchor.lean:23) needs 1 ≤ a < p and gives `Scout a` with constant (1−a/p)⁻¹c. Only a = R/2 gives 2C and fee = 4e/(rR), and that requires R ≥ 2. For 1 < R < 2 the admissible a ≥ 1 gives a worse constant. `gardenL` (Amp/Head.lean:77) is built by mkContinuous with no symmetry lemma, so the claim stands.
